verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs say it generates interactive API documentation from OpenAPI spec files, including automatic endpoint pages, request builders and navigation. Its API-reference use-case page says these docs are generated from the spec you already maintain and updated every time it changes. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how sync is triggered when the spec changes (e.g. remote spec URL or repo-push rebuild), and independent or hands-on corroboration that generation and sync work as claimed.
